cv.name: Conor Walsh
cv.headline: Operations Manager – Food delivery & last-mile logistics
cv.summary: Operations professional with four years in last-mile delivery, recently promoted to run day-to-day operations for a Dublin dark-store network. Practical, data-minded and used to fixing problems on the floor.

experience.title: Operations Manager
bullets: Run daily operations for four dark stores with around 90 pickers and riders
Cut average order-to-door time from 31 to 24 minutes by redesigning store layouts and shift patterns
Plan weekly rosters and labour budgets against demand forecasts
Handle health and safety, incident reporting and HACCP audits

experience.title: Operations Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated rider scheduling and monitored live delivery performance
Introduced a daily stock-accuracy check that reduced substitutions

experience.title: Shift Supervisor
bullets: Supervised a sorting team of 20 on night shifts

education.degree: BSc Logistics and Supply Chain Management
